verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a tenant-level switch for whether AI features are available at all. That is an adjacent control, not a documented guarantee or opt-out that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. Nothing in the pack addresses model training on customer data, so this applicable privacy axis has no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: You will additionally have control over whether AI is available in your tenant, and for which features.
